Parason: Revealing Subtask- and Trial Parallelism
in LLM Reasoning

Zhengyang Zhang Affiliation:  Tsinghua University    Zijian Zhang Affiliation:  Tsinghua University Affiliation:  NVIDIA    Jiaxuan Gao Affiliation:  Tsinghua University    Shusheng Xu Affiliation: Independent Researcher    Yi Wu Affiliation:  Tsinghua University    Song Han Affiliation: Massachusetts Institute of Technology Affiliation:  NVIDIA    Ligeng Zhu ††thanks: ligengz@nvidia.com Affiliation:  NVIDIA
Abstract

Scaling test-time reasoning has substantially improved the problem-solving ability of large language models (LLMs), but standard autoregressive decoding still executes long reasoning traces sequentially, creating severe latency for difficult tasks (up to days and weeks). Parallel reasoning offers a natural remedy. However, prior systems primarily focus on Subtask Parallelism, where the model learns to decompose a high-level task into smaller chunks that can be solved independently. This approach overlooks another pervasive form of parallelism: Trial Parallelism, where multiple speculative attempts explore, verify, and aggregate competing hypotheses in parallel. In this paper, we introduce Parason, which reveals and learns both forms of parallelism in LLM reasoning. Our analysis identifies Trial Parallelism as the majority of parallelizable reasoning computation (65.5% in DeepSeek-V4’s reasoning steps in HLE), and it becomes increasingly dominant on hard problems. Guided by this taxonomy, Parason converts sequential reasoning traces into structured parallel trajectories with a context-free grammar, then trains models with Parallelism-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (PA-GRPO), whose reward jointly balances accuracy, latency, and the two parallelism ratios. At inference time, Parason executes the learned parallel structure through tool calls, translating theoretical savings to real-world wall-clock acceleration. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks including AIME24 and AIME25 show that Parason achieves an average acceleration about 1.7×\times while maintaining competitive accuracy.

1 Introduction

Recent advances in large language model (LLM) reasoning have made a simple recipe increasingly effective: spend more test-time compute, and obtain better answers. Chain-of-Thought prompting (Wei et al., 2022) and reasoning-oriented systems such as OpenAI o1 (OpenAI et al., 2024) and DeepSeek-R1 (DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025) show that long, deliberate reasoning traces can substantially improve performance on mathematical and logical tasks. Yet this recipe has an immediate systems bottleneck. Standard autoregressive decoding serializes every token and every intermediate thought, so stronger reasoning often translates directly into longer waiting time. On difficult problems, reasoning traces can grow to hundreds of thousands or even millions of tokens (Hubert et al., 2025; Luong et al., 2025), making the usual “think longer” strategy impractical for interactive agents, coding assistants, and other latency-sensitive applications. For example, Google’s AlphaProof (DeepMind, 2024) requires up to three days to solve challenging problems from the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) 2024, highlighting the extreme latency inherent in current sequential reasoning systems.

A natural response is to make reasoning parallel: let multiple reasoning branches proceed concurrently instead of decoding every thought in sequence. Existing methods explore this direction through independent sampling, such as self-consistency and Best-of-N (Wang et al., 2022; Hu et al., 2026), or adaptive branching frameworks (Yang et al., 2025b; Jin et al., 2025; Zheng et al., 2025; Lian et al., 2025; Wang et al., 2025). However, methods such as Multiverse (Yang et al., 2025b), ThreadWeaver (Lian et al., 2025), and APR (Pan et al., 2025) mainly exploit subtask-style parallelism: splitting a high-level task into smaller chunks and merging their results. Trial-style exploration, which tries uncertain paths and incorporates diverse trajectories, is less discussed.

在这项工作中，我们认为关键的缺失部分是并行推理的语义分类。如图所示In this work, we argue that the key missing piece is a semantic taxonomy of parallel reasoning. As illustrated in Figure1，我们确定了并行性的两种互补形式。, we identify two complementary forms of parallelism.子任务并行性Subtask Parallelism当问题可以分解为独立的步骤时适用：每个分支解决一个不同的子目标，最终答案结合所有分支结果。这是大多数现有自适应并行系统所强调的形式。applies when a problem can be decomposed into independent steps: each branch solves a distinct sub-goal, and the final answer combines all branch results. This is the form emphasized by most prior adaptive parallel systems.试验并行性Trial Parallelism当模型不确定哪条路径有效时适用：多个分支测试竞争假设，最终轨迹保留有用的结果。这些模式具有不同的执行语义。子任务分支通常都是必需的，而试验分支是推测性的，并且在推理路径不确定时最有用。我们的实证分析表明，这种区别是实际的，而不仅仅是概念上的。对于我们研究的每个模型，试验并行性占人类最后考试中分析的可并行步骤的大部分，包括applies when the model is uncertain about which path will work: multiple branches test competing hypotheses, and the final trajectory keeps the useful results. These modes have different execution semantics. Subtask branches are usually all necessary, while trial branches are speculative and most useful when the reasoning path is uncertain. Our empirical analysis shows that this distinction is practical, not merely conceptual. Trial Parallelism accounts for the majority of analyzed parallelizable steps on Humanity’s Last Exam for every model we study, includingDeepSeek-R1 和 DeepSeek-V4 为 73.8% 和 65.5%73.8% and 65.5% for DeepSeek-R1 and DeepSeek-V4，分别。在 OpenMath 上，它仍然是大多数模型的多数，并且对于相同的两个开源模型分别达到 68.5% 和 58.1%。这表明硬推理不仅仅是分解，更是对不确定的解决路径的尝试和提炼。因此，仅关注子任务分解的系统会错过困难情况下的大部分计算。, respectively. On OpenMath, it remains the majority for most models and reaches 68.5% and 58.1% for the same two open-source models. This suggests that hard reasoning is not only decomposition, but also trying and refining uncertain solution paths. Systems that focus solely on subtask decomposition therefore miss much of the computation in hard cases.

2 相关工作Related Work

LLM 推理的测试时间缩放。Test-time scaling for LLM reasoning.

扩展推理时间计算已成为改进 LLM 推理的核心方法。 CoT 提示Scaling inference-time computation has become a central recipe for improving LLM reasoning. CoT prompting(Wei et al., 2022)引出中间推导，而最近的推理模型，例如 OpenAI o1elicits intermediate derivations, while recent reasoning models such as OpenAI o1(OpenAI et al., 2024)和 DeepSeek-R1and DeepSeek-R1(DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025)通过生成更长、更仔细的推理轨迹来进一步提高性能。这种顺序缩放功能强大但成本高昂：自回归解码会一个接一个地生成每个标记，因此较长的推理会直接增加延迟。并行推理是保留测试时间计算同时缩短最长令牌路径的一个有吸引力的方向。further improve performance by producing longer and more deliberate reasoning traces. This sequential scaling is powerful but expensive: autoregressive decoding generates every token one after another, so longer reasoning directly increases latency. Parallel reasoning is an attractive direction for preserving test-time compute while shortening the longest token path.

独立并行采样和多数表决。Independent parallel sampling and majority voting.

并行推理的一种简单形式是对多个完整解决方案进行采样并汇总它们的答案。自我一致性A simple form of parallel reasoning is to sample multiple complete solutions and aggregate their answers. Self-consistency(Wang et al., 2022)，验证者引导的 Best-of-N 采样, verifier-guided Best-of-N sampling(Cobbe et al., 2021)，以及基于置信度的变体，例如 DeepConf, and confidence-based variants such as DeepConf(Fu et al., 2025)通过探索几个候选轨迹来提高鲁棒性。这些方法隐式地使用试验式计算，因为不同的样本可能会尝试不同的解决方案路径。然而，这些样本是独立的完整轨迹。它们不共享中间工作，不暴露跟踪内的分支结构，也不告诉推理引擎并行执行应该在哪里开始和结束。因此，它们以冗余计算为代价来提高准确性，而对延迟的控制却很少。improve robustness by exploring several candidate trajectories. These methods implicitly use trial-style computation, since different samples may try different solution paths. However, these samples are independent full traces. They do not share intermediate work, expose branch structure inside a trace, or tell an inference engine where parallel execution should begin and end. As a result, they improve accuracy at the cost of redundant computation with little control over latency.

结构化和自适应并行推理。Structured and adaptive parallel reasoning.

PaCoRe further scales test-time compute with multiple rounds of coordinated parallel exploration and message passing. 但他们的主要机制仍然是Yet their main mechanism is still以子任务为中心subtask-centric：模型将高级任务分解为更小的块，并行运行这些块，然后合并结果。当问题承认一个干净的分而治之的结构时，这是有效的，但它错过了困难推理中的常见行为：尝试不确定的路径，拒绝失败的尝试，并保持有效的路径。我们的分析表明，这个缺失: the model decomposes a high-level task into smaller chunks, runs the chunks in parallel, and merges the results. This is effective when the problem admits a clean divide-and-conquer structure, but it misses a common behavior in difficult reasoning: trying uncertain paths, rejecting failed attempts, and keeping the path that works. 3 方法论Methodology

Parason 将长的顺序推理轨迹转化为可执行的并行程序，这对于长期任务（例如 Google 的 AlphaProof）至关重要Parason turns long sequential reasoning traces into executable parallel programs, which is critical for long-horizon tasks such as Google’s AlphaProof(DeepMind, 2024), OpenAI 的 IMO 推理工作, OpenAI’s IMO reasoning efforts(Luong et al., 2025)，以及最近的代理编码工作流程，例如 Claude Code, and recent agentic coding workflows such as Claude Code(Anthropic, 2025a)和 OpenAI Codexand OpenAI Codex(OpenAI, 2025)。该框架分为三个部分。首先，我们定义并行推理的两种语义形式：子任务并行将问题分解为独立的所需部分，而试验并行则探索相互竞争的不确定尝试，并将多样化的探索纳入最终的推理路径。其次，我们定义了上下文无关语法（CFG），它为Parason提供了形式化语法，有助于数据生成、处理和推出避免语法错误，并使后期系统集成变得简单。第三，我们提出了并行感知 GRPO（PA-GRPO），这是一种训练算法，可以教会模型有效地使用并行性，同时保持最终答案的正确性。. The framework has three parts. First, we define two semantic forms of parallel reasoning: Subtask Parallelism decomposes a problem into independent required parts, while Trial Parallelism explores competing uncertain attempts and incorporates the diverse exploration into the final reasoning path. Second, we define a context-free grammar (CFG) that gives Parason a formal syntax, helps data generation, processing, and rollouts avoid syntax errors, and makes later system integration simple. Third, we propose Parallelism-Aware GRPO (PA-GRPO), a training algorithm that teaches the model to use parallelism effectively while preserving final-answer correctness.

3.1 推理中的并行性Parallelism in Reasoning

推理轨迹不是均匀顺序的，如图中试验和子任务并行性的可视化所示A reasoning trace is not uniformly sequential, as shown by the visualization of Trial and Subtask Parallelism in Figure2。有些步骤会得出独立的事实，这些事实将在以后全部使用；其他步骤尝试不确定的想法，探索多种路径，并汇总他们的发现。遵循图中的概述和示例. Some steps derive independent facts that will all be used later; other steps try uncertain ideas, explore multiple paths, and aggregate their findings. Following the overview and examples in Figures1, 2, 和, and3，Parason 将这些行为视为具有不同合并规则的并行性的两种语义形式。, Parason treats these behaviors as two semantic forms of parallelism with different merge rules.

子任务并行性Subtask Parallelism是一个is anAND 分支AND-branch并行形式。一个问题被分成独立的子目标form of parallelism. A problem is split into independent sub-goalsg1,…,gkg_{1},\ldots,g_{k}，每个分支计算一个必要的结果, each branch computes a necessary resultrir_{i}，主轨迹汇总所有结果, and the main trajectory aggregates all results{ri}i=1k\{r_{i}\}_{i=1}^{k}继续推导。这些分支是并行的，因为它们不相互依赖，但它们都是强制性的：删除一个分支将删除生成最终答案所需的信息。例如，几何解决方案可以独立计算两个距离，然后将它们组合到最终公式中。这是先前自适应并行系统所采用的主要形式to continue the derivation. These branches are parallel because they do not depend on one another, but all of them are mandatory: dropping one branch would remove the information required for generating the final answer. For example, a geometry solution may compute two distances independently before combining them in a final formula. This is the dominant form assumed by prior adaptive parallel systems(Yang et al., 2025b; Lian et al., 2025; Pan et al., 2025; Hu et al., 2026).

试验并行性Trial Parallelism是一个is anOR分支OR-branch并行形式。考虑到不确定的状态，模型发起竞争尝试form of parallelism. Given an uncertain state, the model launches competing attemptsa1,…,aka_{1},\ldots,a_{k}测试不同的假设、启发法或解决方案路线。合并步骤连接分支以将探索轨迹合并到推理历史中，而不是选择单个分支。因此，试验并行性是单个推理轨迹内的并行搜索，而不是分解为强制性部分。这反映了强推理模型在解决难题时的表现：它们尝试一条路径，检测到死胡同，然后进行修改。我们的实证分析见表that test different hypotheses, heuristics, or solution routes. The merge step concatenates the branches to incorporate the exploratory trajectories into the reasoning history, rather than selecting a single branch. Thus, Trial Parallelism is parallel search inside a single reasoning trace, rather than decomposition into mandatory parts. This mirrors how strong reasoning models often behave on hard problems: they try a path, detect a dead end, and revise. 3.2 平行轨迹格式Parallel Tracjectory Format

为了使这两种模式可执行，Parason 用语法约束的格式表示推理轨迹。我们延长普通To make these two modes executable, Parason represents reasoning traces with a grammar-constrained format. We extend ordinary<思考><think>具有并行标签的跟踪：traces with parallel tags:<并行><Parallel>标记一个平行区域，marks a parallel region,<概要><Outlines>描述该区域的目的，describes the purpose of the region,<子任务><Subtask>和and<试炼><Trial>标记分支类型，mark branch type,<主题><Thread>存储分支结果。完整的CFG如图所示stores branch outcome. The full CFG is shown in Figure4。虽然现实世界的推理经常表现出混合的依赖关系（例如，子任务内部产生试验分支），但为了简单起见，我们的训练数据保持严格的分离。然而，我们观察到该模型可以在评估过程中推广到这些复杂的成分。. While real-world reasoning often exhibits mixed dependencies (e.g., a subtask internally spawning trial branches), our training data keeps a strict separation for simplicity. However, we observe that the model can generalize to these complex compositions during evaluation.

该格式是围绕两个要求设计的。首先，它是The format is designed around two requirements. First, it is语义semantic：标签指示一个分支是必要的子任务还是推测的试验分支，而不仅仅是它可以并行运行。这很重要，因为先前的并行推理方法通常在单个分支接口下混合两种形式，使得很难决定分支是否应该全部合并或聚合作为探索历史。其次，它是: the tags indicate whether a branch is a necessary subtask or a speculative trial branch, not merely that it can run in parallel. This matters because prior parallel-reasoning methods often mix the two forms under a single branching interface, making it hard to decide whether branches should be all merged or aggregated as exploration history. Second, it is引擎可解析engine-parseable：每个分支都有明确的开始和停止标签，因此推理运行时可以在不修改模型架构的情况下调度工作人员。与自由形式的摘要或仅提示相比，CFG 在共享合约下提供训练和推理。: each branch has explicit start and stop tags, so an inference runtime can dispatch workers without modifying the model architecture. Compared with free-form summaries or prompt-only, the CFG gives the training and inference infra a shared contract.

第一项将正确性作为主要信号，为不正确的答案分配负的基本奖励，为正确的答案分配正的基本奖励。延迟项，加权为The first term makes correctness the primary signal by assigning a negative base reward to incorrect answers and a positive base reward to correct answers. The latency term, weighted byα\alpha，惩罚具有高归一化关键路径延迟的轨迹。子任务和试验激励，加权为, penalizes trajectories with high normalized critical-path latency. The Subtask and Trial incentives, weighted byβsubtask\beta_{\text{subtask}}和andβtrial\beta_{\text{trial}}，鼓励有用的并行结构，而修剪的加速奖励直接有利于相对于总生成长度的关键路径的减少。重要的是要注意, encourage useful parallel structure, while the clipped acceleration reward directly favors reductions in the critical path relative to total generation length. It is important to note thatβsubtask\beta_{\text{subtask}}和andβtrial\beta_{\text{trial}}针对根本不同的优化目标：试验并行通过用总令牌换取搜索宽度来提高准确性，而子任务并行通过压缩最长令牌路径来减少延迟。在实践中，这个奖励让我们可以单独调整这两个维度，如第 1 节中详细介绍的target fundamentally different optimization goals: Trial Parallelism improves accuracy by trading total tokens for search width, while Subtask Parallelism reduces latency by compressing the longest token path. In practice, this reward lets us separately tune these two dimensions, as detailed in Section4.2.

3.4 集成到现代推理引擎中Integration into Modern Inference Engine

Parason 通过将并行分支视为工具调用而不需要深度运行时更改来与现代推理引擎集成。遵循图中的CFGParason integrates with modern inference engines by treating parallel branches as tool calls rather than requiring deep runtime changes. Following the CFG in Figure4，运行时正常解码，直到, the runtime decodes normally until a<并行><Parallel>区域出现，解析region appears, parses the<概要><Outlines>，调度每个, dispatches each<子任务><Subtask> or <试炼><Trial>作为独立工作者，并返回结果as an independent worker, and returns the resulting<主题><Thread>输出到主轨迹；图outputs to the main trajectory; Figure3在 24 Puzzle 上显示了这种格式。 X语法shows this format on the 24 Puzzle. XGrammar(Dong et al., 2024)强制执行有效标签，我们在 SGLang 中实现此工具调用执行enforces valid tags, and we implement this tool-call execution in SGLang(Zheng et al., 2023).

4 实验Experiments

我们在下面提供有关培训数据管理、培训框架和评估的详细信息，并将开源我们的实施以促进可重复性。We provide details on training data curation, training framework, and evaluation below, and will open-source our implementation to facilitate reproducibility.

培训数据管理。Training Data Curation.

我们从 ThreadWeaver 发布的 964 个带注释的 Qwen3-8B 跟踪中构建并行训练数据We build parallel training data from the 964 annotated Qwen3-8B traces released by ThreadWeaver(Lian et al., 2025)。 Gemini-3-Flash 将每个并行阶段标记为子任务或试验；对于试验阶段，Qwen3-8B 采样额外的分支，Gemini-3-Flash 生成它们的分支. Gemini-3-Flash labels each parallel stage as Subtask or Trial; for Trial stages, Qwen3-8B samples extra branches and Gemini-3-Flash generates their<试炼><Trial>目标。对于强化学习 (RL)，我们使用 Polaris-53kgoals. For reinforcement learning (RL), we use Polaris-53k(An et al., 2025)，收录了约53,000个复杂推理问题。, a collection of about 53,000 complex reasoning problems.

培训框架。Training Framework.

我们使用两阶段的训练后管道。首先，我们用TRL对模型进行微调We use a two-stage post-training pipeline. First, we fine-tune the model with TRL(von Werra et al., 2020)在策划的平行轨迹上。其次，我们用VeRL进行训练on the curated parallel trajectories. Second, we train with VeRL(Sheng et al., 2024)使用并行感知 GRPO (PA-GRPO)。除非另有说明，RL 使用学习率using Parallelism-Aware GRPO (PA-GRPO). Unless otherwise noted, RL uses learning rate1​e−61\mathrm{e}{-6}，批量大小 128，8 个卷展栏，下剪裁比 0.2，上剪裁比 0.28； SFT使用学习率, batch size 128, 8 rollouts, lower clip ratio 0.2, and upper clip ratio 0.28; SFT uses learning rate1​e−51\mathrm{e}{-5}，批量大小 16，8 个时期，以及一个余弦学习率调度器。, batch size 16, 8 epochs, and a cosine learning-rate scheduler.

评价。Evaluation.

我们对 AIME 2024 进行评估We evaluate on AIME 2024(Mathematical Association of America, 2024), AIME 2025 (Mathematical Association of America, 2025), 资产管理公司, AMC(Mathematical Association of America, 2023), 数学500, Math500(Hendrycks et al., 2021)，和密涅瓦数学, and Minerva Math(Lewkowycz et al., 2022)，并与从相同基础模型和数据源以及外部并行和高效推理系统训练的顺序基线进行比较。我们报告最终答案的准确性和可执行延迟。对于帕拉森来说，, and compare against sequential baselines trained from the same base model and data source as well as external parallel and efficient-reasoning systems. We report final-answer accuracy and executable latency. For Parason,模型延迟model latency是最长生成路径的令牌长度：顺序令牌通常被计数，而每个is the token length of the longest generation path: sequential tokens are counted normally, while each<并行><Parallel>块贡献最大分支长度而不是所有分支的总和。该指标捕获了同时运行分支的推理引擎可用的挂钟优势。block contributes the maximum branch length rather than the sum of all branches. This metric captures the wall-clock benefit available to an inference engine that runs branches concurrently.

4.1 主要结果Main Results

Parason 比之前的并行推理系统提高了准确性。Parason improves accuracy over prior parallel reasoning systems.表Table2将 Parason 与现有的并行和高效推理方法进行了比较。 Parason 在列出的系统中提供了最佳的 AIME25 和 AMC 结果报告，达到了 Parason 最好的四基准平均准确度 84.7%，并且在 AIME24 上与 ThreadWeaver 保持接近。跨越原始设置和附加设置compares Parason with existing parallel and efficient-reasoning methods. Parason gives the best reported AIME25 and AMC results among the listed systems, reaches the best Parason four-benchmark average accuracy of 84.7%, and stays close to ThreadWeaver on AIME24. Across the original settings and the additionalα=0.1\alpha=0.1运行后，PA-GRPO 在 AIME25 上达到 70.6%，在 AMC 上达到 97.5%，在 Math500 上达到 94.6%。这些成果表明，与之前的并行工作相比，Parason 提高了准确性和平均基准覆盖率，尽管它使用 8B 模型而不是多个 32B 基线。runs, PA-GRPO reaches 70.6% on AIME25, 97.5% on AMC, and 94.6% on Math500. These gains show that Parason improves both accuracy and average benchmark coverage over prior parallel work, even though it uses an 8B model rather than several 32B baselines.

Parason 在约束条件下提供了更好的令牌延迟准确度权衡。Parason gives a better token-latency–accuracy trade-off under constraints.表Table3表明当模型在最长令牌路径上的思考预算较小时，Parason 最有用。在 2048 个令牌时，最佳的子任务感知 PA-GRPO 模型达到了 34.7% AIME24 准确度，而仅 SFT 的准确度为 16.8%。在 8192 个代币中，它达到了 60.3%，而在相同预算下 SFT 仅为 41.8%。因此，Parason 并不是简单地花费更多的代币；而是花费更多的代币。它将有用的工作转移到并行分支中，并保持最长的路径较短。shows that Parason is most useful when the model has a small thinking budget on the longest token path. At 2048 tokens, the best Subtask-aware PA-GRPO model reaches 34.7% AIME24 accuracy, compared with 16.8% for SFT only. At 8192 tokens, it reaches 60.3%, compared with 41.8% for SFT only at the same budget. Thus, Parason does not simply spend more tokens; it moves useful work into parallel branches and keeps the longest path short.

更难的问题会创造更多可并行的工作，而不是更少的加速。Harder questions create more parallelizable work, not less acceleration.表Table5按难度分解step-200 AIME24 跑步。生成的代币随着难度的增加而急剧增长，从简单问题的 21.3k 到中等问题的 36.8k 和困难问题的 50.3k。最长的令牌路径也会增长，但速度要慢得多：分别为 12.5k、21.2k 和 29.0k 令牌。结果，帕拉森保持稳定的1.70-1.74breaks down the step-200 AIME24 run by difficulty. Generated tokens grow sharply with difficulty, from 21.3k on easy problems to 36.8k on medium problems and 50.3k on hard problems. The longest token path also grows, but much more slowly: 12.5k, 21.2k, and 29.0k tokens, respectively. As a result, Parason keeps a stable 1.70–1.74×\times所有三个难度组的代币级加速比。这意味着测得的挂钟加速为 1.62token-level acceleration ratio across all three difficulty groups. This translates into measured wall-clock speedups of 1.62×\times简单，1.38on easy, 1.38×\times中等，1.47on medium, and 1.47×\times关于难题。保存的令牌的绝对数量从简单问题的 8.8k 增加到困难问题的 21.3k，这表明较难的问题暴露了更多可以移出关键路径的分支级工作。这支持了 Parason 的核心动机：困难的推理仍然需要长时间且多样化的计算，但大部分计算不需要保持串行。on hard problems. The absolute number of saved tokens increases from 8.8k on easy problems to 21.3k on hard problems, showing that harder questions expose more branch-level work that can be moved off the critical path. This supports the central motivation of Parason: difficult reasoning still requires long and diverse computation, but much of that computation does not need to remain serial.

5 结论Conclusion

在这项工作中，我们介绍了In this work, we introduced帕拉森Parason，一种算法系统协同设计框架，可为顺序 LLM 推理带来并行处理。帕拉森区分确定性, an algorithm-system co-design framework that brings parallel processing to sequential LLM reasoning. Parason distinguishes deterministic子任务并行性Subtask Parallelism来自投机from speculative试验并行性Trial Parallelism，并为数据管理、基于 CFG 的结构、PA-GRPO 训练和推理引擎执行提供稳定的管道。这种设计可实现高效的并行推理，并提高交互代理、编码助手和科学问题解决工具的响应能力。我们的研究结果表明，尽管先前的工作主要集中在子任务分解上，但试验并行性是复杂数学推理的关键机制。在基准测试中，Parason 减少了, and provides a stable pipeline for data curation, CFG-based structure, PA-GRPO training, and inference-engine execution. This design enables efficient parallel reasoning and improves the responsiveness of interactive agents, coding assistants, and scientific problem-solving tools. Our findings show that Trial Parallelism is a key mechanism for complex mathematical reasoning, although prior work has mainly focused on subtask decomposition. Across benchmarks, Parason reduces令牌延迟约token latency by about1.7×1.7\times同时while保持可比较的准确性maintaining comparable accuracy。我们希望 Parason 提高社区对并行推理及其两种并行方案的认识，并激发未来关于更高效和可扩展的推理系统的工作。我们在附录中包含了限制和影响声明. We hope Parason raises the community’s awareness of parallel reasoning and its two parallelism schemes, and inspires future work on more efficient and scalable reasoning systems. We include limitations and the impact statement in AppendixA，并将开源我们的实现以支持可重复性。, and will open-source our implementation to support reproducibility.

附录AAppendix A局限性和未来的工作Limitations and Future Work

帕拉森的训练和评估主要集中在数学推理上。目前尚不清楚相同的分类法、数据管理管道和 PA-GRPO 目标转移到其他领域（例如现实世界的代理）的效果如何。其次，我们目前的实验主要集中在 8B 尺度的模型上。此设置为研究并行推理提供了一个受控测试平台，但它并没有完全显示 Parason 在模型系列和大小上的行为方式。在未来的工作中，我们将把 Parason 扩展到更多的主干和更大的模型，以研究相同的并行模式和延迟增益是否适用于更广泛的规模。Parason’s training and evaluation mainly focus on mathematical reasoning. It remains unclear how well the same taxonomy, data curation pipeline, and PA-GRPO objective transfer to other domains, such as real-world agents. Second, our current experiments focus on 8B-scale models. This setting provides a controlled testbed for studying parallel reasoning, but it does not fully show how Parason behaves across model families and sizes. In future work, we will scale Parason to more backbones and larger models to study whether the same parallelism patterns and latency gains hold at broader scales.

附录BAppendix B用于数据管理的提示Prompts Used for Data Curation

我们使用以下提示来识别 LLM 推理轨迹中的试验和子任务步骤。We use the following prompts to identify Trial and Subtask steps in LLM reasoning trajectories.

对于开源模型，我们首先将每个推理轨迹划分为For open-source models, we first split each reasoning trajectory by\n\n。第一个提示通过确定每个段是开始新的子问题还是继续前一个子问题来重建逻辑步骤。然后，第二个提示将每个逻辑步骤分类为试验步骤或子任务步骤。. The first prompt reconstructs logical steps by deciding whether each segment starts a new subproblem or continues a previous one. The second prompt then classifies each logical step as either a Trial step or a Subtask step.

对于商业模型，已发布的推理摘要已经用“***Step i***”标记步骤。因此，我们直接应用第二个提示将每个标记的步骤分类为试验或子任务。For commercial models, the released reasoning summaries already mark steps with “***Step i***”. We therefore apply the second prompt directly to classify each marked step as Trial or Subtask.
